lines.zh: 四条腿踩过森林的湿地
lines.en: Four legs cross the forest's wet ground

lines.zh: 我头顶那块冠，走起来一晃
lines.en: The crest on my head sways as I walk
My kin and I walk in a line

lines.zh: 我伸着脖子，一眼看得很远
lines.en: My neck stretched, I see far

lines.zh: 树根很多，我得挑着落脚
lines.en: The roots are many, I pick my footing

lines.zh: 我走着，尾巴在后面平衡
lines.en: My tail balances me behind

lines.zh: 我走走停停，闻一闻树皮
lines.en: I walk and stop to sniff the bark
This forest is thick with growth

lines.zh: 我踩着落果，壳响了一声
lines.en: I step on a fallen fruit and the shell cracks

lines.zh: 我抬头，高处叶子太嫩了
lines.en: I look up, the high leaves are too young
My kin are ahead, I am behind
One step after another, unhurried

lines.zh: 我一边走一边啃低处的叶
lines.en: I nibble low leaves as I walk

lines.zh: 我们走过的地方，灌木都被压开
lines.en: Where we pass, the brush is pushed apart
I keep my head up, chewing the high leaves
My crest shows above the brush
I stand on four steady legs
The forest light comes in patches
I chew slowly, for a long while
I turn my head to look
Insects fly around my legs
I move my neck a little
My kin are eating a few steps away
I lower my head and drink

lines.zh: 我身体的影子罩住一片草
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of grass

lines.zh: 我把脖子绕到背上，挠一下
lines.en: I bend my neck over my back to scratch
There are a few pale lines on my crest

lines.zh: 你从树后出来，我看见了
lines.en: You came out from behind the tree, I saw
I lower my head, my neck curving
Your head only reaches my chest

lines.zh: 这片林子，我们走了很多年
lines.en: We have walked this forest many years
I do not start trouble, but I kick
There are no leaves in your hands
I tilt my head, my crest a little off
Are you looking at the crest on my head

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚下草被踩倒
lines.en: I step back, flattening the grass

lines.zh: 你站那儿不动，我也就不动
lines.en: Stand still and I will too

lines.zh: 树上还有叶子，够我们吃
lines.en: There are leaves enough on the trees for us
I have not met your smell before

lines.zh: 我从喉咙里发出一点声音
lines.en: A small sound came from my throat
My crest swayed
A tear in my hide
I raise my head to see clearly
I dislike fighting, and I answer
Blood falls on the leaves
Your blow came with force
My four legs take it steadily
I stretch my neck over
These leaves, gone in two bites
I take it slowly
Young leaves are sweeter than old

lines.zh: 你举得太低了，我得低头
lines.en: You hold it too low, I have to bow
When I finish I raise my head to you
I have not eaten this kind of leaf
Keep your hand flat, I do not bite

lines.zh: 再给一点，我就不管别的了
lines.en: A little more and I ignore everything else

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我倒退半步
lines.en: You hit my leg and I step back half a pace

lines.zh: 帘子一样的冠晃了一下
lines.en: My crest sways like a curtain
I shifted my weight
Do not rub along my legs
You backed off, the grass trampled
I slowly move aside

lines.zh: 你这么小，撞一下没什么
lines.en: You are so small, a bump means little
I stepped back so as not to tread on you
Bump again and I use my hind legs

lines.zh: 林子里我们一群，各有各的
lines.en: We are a herd here, each with their own

lines.zh: 我冠的颜色，是给别人看的
lines.en: The color of my crest is meant to be seen
Stand steady, let me see your crest
There are not enough leaves to go around
I will walk over slowly, no hurry
This forest has many sounds
You walk even slower than I do
Better when several of us are together
I rub my head against a trunk
It is getting dark, back to the herd
I lower my head, the ground is in reach
This is not like a leaf
I spat it out and tossed my head
It fell from my mouth
I push at it with the tip of my snout

lines.zh: 冠饰一晃，我低头把它踩稳。
lines.en: My crest sways as I lower my head and pin it down.
There is nothing here I can use
You take it, my mouth is clumsy
There is movement beyond the trees
I raise my head, my crest lifting
My kin have stopped eating too
You snapped a branch
The herd draws together
I set my four legs wide
I do not call out, I watch first
We know this place, you do not
Your shadow is on the trunk
One call and the whole herd comes
I lower my head, crest forward
There is only one path ahead
I heard it, footsteps
We close the young into the middle

lines.zh: 你往林子里走，那里更暗
lines.en: You head into the trees, it is darker there
Several of us, walking a half circle
The trees are too thick for you to run
My neck is long, I see far

lines.zh: 你绕过树干，我直接过去
lines.en: You go around the trunk, I go through the gap

lines.zh: 我的冠在树影里很显眼
lines.en: My crest shows clearly in the shade
Ahead is a swamp, you will not cross
I stay on your rear quarter
You stop, and we stop too

lines.zh: 这林子里到处是我的脚印
lines.en: My prints are all over this forest
Further on and you cannot turn back
My breathing is loud
I know every tree here
The circle, we have closed it

lines.zh: 我慢慢走过来，不惊动谁
lines.en: I walk over slowly, startling nothing
A hind leg kicks you
I drive my skull into you
That was heavy, you flew
My tail swings and you lose your footing

lines.zh: 我整个身子的重量压下来
lines.en: My whole weight comes down
You retreat, and we follow

lines.zh: 这一下我的冠晃得厉害
lines.en: That shook my crest hard
I hit the trunk and the tree groans
The trees have closed you in
That dented your armor
Several of us press in at once
I lift a foot, do not stand there
You rolled into the brush
That will keep you down a while

lines.zh: 林子里多了一个高影子
lines.en: A tall shadow has joined the forest
I walk out of the trees

lines.zh: 我的冠先露在灌木上面
lines.en: My crest shows above the brush first

lines.zh: 我们几只从不同的方向来
lines.en: Several of us come from different directions

lines.zh: 落地那下，我四条腿撑住了
lines.en: On landing, four legs took the weight
Leaves fall where I brush past
I stretch my neck to look

lines.zh: 这林子养了我们很多年
lines.en: This forest has fed us for years

lines.zh: 我踩在落叶上，声音很闷
lines.en: My feet on the leaves sound muffled

lines.zh: 我抬脚，抖了抖腿上的泥
lines.en: I lift a foot and shake the mud off
Every bird in the forest takes flight
I stop in a forest clearing
A patch of grass is flattened by me
My kin come up behind me
The distant treeline shifted
I did not call, I stand quietly

lines.zh: 火烧到我的冠，气味刺鼻
lines.en: Fire caught my crest, the smell is sharp

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，压倒一片草
lines.en: I rolled down the slope, flattening the grass

lines.zh: 这里是沼泽，我陷进去了
lines.en: It is a swamp here, and I am sinking
The blast numbed my neck

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我的脖子上
lines.en: An arrow is in my neck
That force went into my legs

lines.zh: 树上的叶子都被吃光了
lines.en: The leaves on the trees are all gone
Lightning hit the treetop and my legs gave
No trees here, and no grass
